blocks.text: Following their US debut and Billboard 200 entry, BE:FIRST celebrate their fifth anniversary with their first original album in nearly two years, led by the hip-hop anthem “NOW U KNOW”. The six-member Japanese dance and vocal group marks their fifth anniversary on 3 November with the release of their fourth album “BE:4U”, a 13-track collection bringing together new music, unit songs and a newly recorded version of “Mainstream”. The album arrives after a year of major milestones, including BE:FIRST’s US debut and an entry on the Billboard 200.
